prerequisites: Mathematics I and II from Bachillerato

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering.
Aptitude to apply knowledge about: differential and integral calculus.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling learning new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Honesty, responsibility, ethical commitment, and a spirit of solidarity.
Ability to work in a team.
Operate and represent real functions of a real variable, obtain their limits, determine their continuity, calculate derivatives and formulate and solve optimization problems.
Manage the concepts of sequences and series and use power series to represent functions.
Formulate and calculate integrals of one-variable functions and apply them to solving engineering-related problems.
State and apply the basic properties of real functions of several real variables. Obtain their limits, analyze continuity and differentiability, and solve optimization problems.

assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, the final grade is calculated as 0.15 x PL + maximum (0.15 x PA + 0.7 x TE, 0.85 x TE). All scores are out of 10 points. It is mandatory to obtain at least 3.5 points out of 10 in the Theoretical Exam (TE) to pass. If the minimums are not met, the grade will be a fail with the numerical score of TE. For extraordinary examinations, a single exam comprises a theoretical part (TE), where a minimum of 3.5 points is required, and Laboratory Practices (PL) can either keep the ordinary period score or be re-examined. Classroom Practices (PA) scores from the ordinary period are retained. The final grade calculation is the same as the ordinary exam if all minimums are reached, otherwise the grade will be a fail with the numerical score of TE.
